name: S4. Best-selling products and margin
rawText:
# Do you know which products generate the highest profits and deliver the best profit margins?
#  - Which products generate the highest gross profit?
#  - Which products sell the most units and generate the highest net revenue?
#  - Which products deliver the strongest profit margins?
#  - Are our best-selling products also our most profitable products?
#  - Which products generate high revenue but have relatively low profit margins?
#  - How much does product cost affect the profitability of each product?
#  - Which product categories contribute the most to overall product profitability?
#  - Are discounts significantly reducing the profit margins of certain products?
#  - Which products should we prioritize to maximize revenue and profitability?
# __________________________________________________

ProductMargin is OrderItems: Product.Id ProductId,
    Product.Name Product,
    Product.Category Category,
    Count(distinct Order.Id) OrderCount,
    SUM(Quantity) UnitsSold,
    SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice - DiscountAmount).Round(2) NetRevenue,
    SUM(Quantity * (UnitPrice - Product.CostPrice) - DiscountAmount).Round(2) GrossProfit,
    (<100> * SUM(Quantity * (UnitPrice - Product.CostPrice) - DiscountAmount)
        / NullIf(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice - DiscountAmount), <0>)).Round(2) MarginPercent
  Where Order.Status = <Completed>
  Order GrossProfit DESC
  Take 10

field.field:
(<100> * SUM(Quantity * (UnitPrice - Product.CostPrice) - DiscountAmount)
/ NullIf(SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice - DiscountAmount), <0>)).Round(2)
